subject: PO allocation audit + spend cap correction for Pioneer Analytics
messages:
From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@pioneer-analytics.com>
To: rachel_kim@redwood.com, procurement@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding: Pioneer Analytics — PO request & spend cap

Hi Rachel / Redwood procurement team,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. Attached is our completed onboarding form for Pioneer Analytics. We're ready to be added as a vendor and would like a PO number issued so we can start the implementation next week. A few details: 

- Requested initial spend cap: $50,000 (we expect monthly run rate ~ $8–10k after go-live)
- Billing entity: Pioneer Analytics, Inc.
- Primary billing contact: finance@pioneer-analytics.com (cc'd)
- Line items: Hosted API (SKU: RWI-HOST-STD) — qty 1 — monthly subscription, plus usage overage.

One item to flag: the onboarding form references SKU RWI-HOST-STD at $6,000/mo but our procurement team has a differing unit price in the quote PDF; please advise if we should expect a line-item update.

Attachments: Pioneer_Onboarding_Form.pdf; quote.pdf

We need the PO on file by 08/03 to align with our internal vendor activation window. Let me know what other docs you need (W-9, bank info).

Thanks,
Maya Patel
Vendor Ops — Pioneer Analytics
maya.patel@pioneer-analytics.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: rachel_kim@redwood.com
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@pioneer-analytics.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2026 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding: Pioneer Analytics — PO request & spend cap

Hi Maya — thanks for sending the form. Quick clarifying questions so we can move the PO forward:

1) Can you confirm the legal name to appear on the PO exactly (legal entity vs DBA)?
2) Is the $50k requested as an initial cap (one-time) or a rolling monthly cap? Our onboarding process supports provisional PO issuance at a conservative cap while we complete finance checks.
3) Regarding the SKU pricing mismatch — can you point me to the quote file/version that Pioneer is using (attachment name or sales rep)? If the quote has an override we'll need that documented.

Cc'ing Laura from Procurement — she will own the PO issuance and spend-cap approvals. If you can return a signed onboarding form plus W-9 we can expedite.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Account Lead, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: rachel_kim@redwood.com, Maya Patel <maya.patel@pioneer-analytics.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2026 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding: Pioneer Analytics — PO request & spend cap (provisional PO issued)

Hi all — looping in Procurement ops to confirm next steps. Per our standard process we can issue a provisional PO while finance completes vendor onboarding. I've generated a provisional PO to cover the initial provisioning period: 

- PO#: RWI-2026-789312 (provisional)
- Provisional cap: $25,000 (to cover first 30 days)
- Intended full cap after approval: $50,000

Note on line items: we found a price discrepancy on SKU RWI-HOST-STD — quote.pdf listed $6,000/mo, the sales quote in our CRM shows $5,500/mo. Procurement will default to the most recent signed quote or documented approval; for now we've used $6,000 in the provisional PO to match the vendor form. I've attached a short line_item_change_log.csv documenting the mismatch and the correction we recommend if Pioneer confirms the $5,500 price.

Attachments: PO_RWI-2026-789312_provisional.pdf; line_item_change_log.csv

Next steps for Maya/Pioneer: please return the signed onboarding form and W-9. Once Finance confirms vendor banking info and tax docs we can lift the provisional cap to $50k and re-issue a final PO number (or amend the provisional PO).

If Pioneer needs the full $50k applied immediately (to avoid internal procurement gating on your side), please indicate that and Procurement will fast-track an approval request — will need sign-off from Finance and Legal.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, rachel_kim@redwood.com
Cc: Maya Patel <maya.patel@pioneer-analytics.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding: Pioneer Analytics — PO request & spend cap (procurement note)

Thanks Ben — I submitted the approval ticket to Finance this morning (request ID FIN-3321). A couple of operational notes for Pioneer to avoid invoice rejections: 

- Please ensure the billing/legal name on invoices exactly matches the legal name on the PO (Pioneer Analytics, Inc.).
- Use billing code: COSTCENTER-ENG-044 (this must appear on the invoice for chargeback).
- Update line item description to: "Redwood Inference - Hosted API (monthly)" rather than the generic SKU label — our AR system uses that description to map to the subscription ledger.

I increased the priority on the approval request and linked the HubSpot company record (see link). If Finance signs off today we'll lift the provisional cap to $50k and update PO RWI-2026-789312 with the final amount.

Laura Bennett
Procurement Director
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@pioneer-analytics.com>
To: rachel_kim@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@pioneer-analytics.com
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding: Pioneer Analytics — PO request & spend cap (signed onboarding)

Hi Rachel / Laura / Ben — thanks for the quick turnaround and for issuing the provisional PO. A couple quick confirmations: 

1) We'll sign and return the onboarding form today (attaching signed copy).
2) Pioneer confirms the price should be $5,500/mo (we were given an internal discount); please update the final PO when you lift the provisional cap. The provisional PO is fine to get us through the vendor activation window.
3) For invoicing: please confirm whether PO# RWI-2026-789312 must appear on the invoice to avoid processing delays (our AR team prefers the PO number present). Also provide remittance instructions or the AR mailbox.

Attachments: Pioneer_Signed_Onboarding_Form.pdf

Thanks,
Maya Patel
Vendor Ops — Pioneer Analytics
maya.patel@pioneer-analytics.com
